# CANDIDATE: EXTENDED_DTE_STUDY_VWAP_CONTINUATION_ITM2_3_4_DTE

**Filed:** 2026-07-12
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** Structural DTE/hold finding (extended to 3-4 DTE)
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE dimension beyond 2DTE to 3DTE and 4DTE for the VWAP_CONTINUATION signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) will continue to show increasing OOS expectancy per trade due to reduced theta decay on entry premium, or will plateau/reverse due to widening spreads and lower liquidity in longer-dated options. This tests whether the "less theta" hypothesis holds for further DTE extensions.

## Mechanism

Identical to WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE: VWAP_CONTINUATION signal triggers entry at next bar open. Strike = ITM-2. Stop = -8% of entry premium. Target = +30% of entry premium. DTE varied across {0,1,2,3,4}. OPRA data for 3DTE and 4DTE fetched via `tools/expand_opra_cache.py` before running `multiday_dte_compare.py`. OOS expectancy per trade calculated over walk-forward held-out window. Concentration measured as top-5 days % of total P&L per DTE bucket.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account to fit per-trade risk cap; $1K paper account realizes ~14% of headline P&L (same as WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = number of signals in OOS window per DTE (unknown until backtest). Selection method: all VWAP_CONTINUATION signals in OPRA data for DTE=0-4. Overfit risk low (single parameter sweep, 5 values).
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS expectancy per trade computed via walk-forward (held-out window) for each DTE; results pending Stage-1 backtest.
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top-3 J day validation using cached real OPRA fills with bid/ask/slippage model not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: large adverse gap through chart stop (e.g., 5/07 SPY 734C loss scenario extended to longer DTE).
   - Max drawdown: sequence of consecutive losses exacerbated by wider stops in higher DTE.
   - Blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing multiple simultaneous stop outs exceeding daily loss limit.
6. **Concentration:** To be computed post-backtest (top-5 days % of P&L per DTE bucket; expect higher concentration at longer DTE due to fewer samples).

## Pre-merge gate

- `test_multiday_dte_compare.py` must pass (extended to validate 3DTE/4DTE logic).
- Walk-forward OOS expectancy per trade > 0 for all DTE buckets.
- Real-fills validation on top-3 J days shows <20% diff from BS sim.
- Concentration check: top-5 days ≤ 200% of P&L (avoid extreme tail dependence).
